patthana10.5:1.1: na kusalaṃ no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kusalaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kusalaṃ na āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kusalaṃ na āsavañceva na anāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na anāsavañceva na nocaāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kusalaṃ na āsavañceva na āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na āsavavippayuttañceva na nocaāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na kusalaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ na anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattika chagocchakadukaṃ na kusalaṃ no saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ no ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ no oghaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ no yogaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ no nīvaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ no parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattika mahantaradukaṃ na kusalaṃ na sārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana10.5:2.1: na kusalaṃ na anārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... saṅkhittaṃ. na
